description: This header file declares functions and structures related to alias management, including alias lookup, command line quoting, splitting command lines, error handling for command splitting, and listing aliases.

methods.name: alias_lookup
methods.description: Returns the string associated with a given alias.

methods.name: split_cmdline
methods.description: Splits a command line string into arguments.

methods.name: split_cmdline_strerror
methods.description: Provides error messages for split_cmdline failures.
